thread:
elena: Hey team — just got my MacBook Pro (M3, company-issued) and trying to install UTM to run an x86 FPGA toolchain. MDM blocks kernel extensions and I can’t get the emulator to start. Anyone who I should ping for a temporary admin or approved workaround?

it-support: Welcome! quick q — do you need full admin or just permission to install UTM/virtualization? sometimes we can approve a cask install instead.

elena: I mainly need to run a Linux VM with qemu user-mode & a few kernel modules for JTAG passthrough. The UTM app fails with: "permission denied: kext load blocked". I don’t want to disable SIP.

sam-platform: @elena can you paste the output of: ```system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial``` and ```spctl --status``` and also whether Kandji shows the device as "enrolled"?

elena: sure — running now:
```
$ system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial
Serial Number (system): ABCD1234EFGH
$ spctl --status
enabled
```
I see `Status: Enrolled (MDM)` in System Settings -> Profiles as well.

kandji-bot: Device ABCD1234EFGH is in scope for standard dev profile. Kernel extension approvals are disabled by org policy. Temporary admin grants require IT approval ticket.

it-support: Thanks. Two options: (1) we can create a short-lived local admin for you (default 72h) so you can install the tooling; or (2) use our Linux cloud devbox (image already has qemu+openocd) — which one do you prefer?

elena: cloud devbox might be fine for builds, but I need the USB/JTAG passthrough locally for debugging hardware at my desk. so temporary admin would be best.

sam-platform: Ok — file a ticket in #help with the serial and justify (hardware debugging + JTAG). Put "temp-admin-3d" in the subject and tag @it-support. We'll attach an approval flow.

it-support: filing note: we can approve for 72 hours with conditions: no SIP disable, no tampering with MDM agent, and you must run the pre-install checklist. Once we grant, run: ```sudo /usr/sbin/installer -pkg /path/to/UTM.pkg -target /``` or prefer Homebrew cask: ```brew install --cask utm``` — but if kexts still block, we’ll provide the explicit entitlement.

devex: FYI, if you need reproducible debugging later we can also help set up a USB-over-IP bridge on the devbox so you can keep hardware connected remotely. saves admin requests long-term.

elena: great — I filed the ticket with subject: "temp-admin-3d ABCD1234 - UTM for JTAG debugging" and included the serial + justification. pinged @it-support.

it-support: got it. approving pending manager sign-off. when approved we’ll DM you the temporary admin creds and a short checklist (also logs to be collected at revoke time).

elena: awesome — thanks all :tada:

sam-platform: quick security note for future readers — if your workflow needs kernel-level USB passthrough we generally prefer vendors with driverless userspace tools; we’re working on vendor guidance to minimize devs needing local admin.

elena: good to know — appreciate the help!

it-support: after install, if any prompts about "system extensions" appear, take a screenshot and upload to the ticket. we’ll help remote-in if needed.

elena: will do. thanks again! :pray:
